beliefs: f changes the last character of alphabetic strings to the next letter in the alphabet (a->b, ..., z->a), leaving the rest unchanged [E1]
Strings ending in non-letters (digits, symbols, spaces) are returned unchanged [E1]
Case is preserved: uppercase last letters advance within uppercase [E1]
For 'hello'->'hellp', 'abc'->'abd', 'xyz'->'xya', 'two words'->'two wordt': only the final letter is incremented [E1]
notes: Observed that only the last character changes, and only when it is a letter, advancing by one with wraparound z->a. Non-letter endings are untouched.
